verdict.rationale: Datalab's own API can generate suggested extraction schemas from a user's file, which is a narrow AI-generated suggestion drawn from the user's data. It also documents running a published agent processor on a document, but the evidence doesn't say what that agent outputs. Most of the story is unevidenced: there is no documented insight generation, analysis, or recommendations about the content. missing for 10: AI-generated insights or summaries about document content, an in-product (UI) suggestion experience, documentation of what agent processors produce, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: For a given file, generate potential extraction schemas.
Run a published agent processor on a document.
